name: Pear Passwords
author: dragosol
description: Your passwords on iCloud, in a native Omarchy window. Sign in with your Apple Account, approve this computer once, and your passwords and verification codes stay actively in sync. Nothing is shown until you unlock with your fingerprint or password. Copy fields with a click, add entries, see password history, generate strong passwords, pair verification codes by scanning a QR code, and keep notes and extra websites. Not affiliated with Apple.
